legacy.flag.absentmembers: Remove tracks added by members who left the channel.
legacy.flag.amount:
Set how many tracks with the given name to move.
Ex: -amount 5
legacy.flag.casesensitive: Search for tracks with the exact phrase in the title instead of matching word by word.
legacy.flag.endposition:
Remove tracks from the queue up to a given position.
Ex: -end 15
legacy.flag.force: Play the added track immediately (only effective if a track is currently playing).
legacy.flag.maxduration:
Remove tracks with the given maximum duration.
Ex: -max 1:23.
legacy.flag.member:
Remove tracks requested by the given user.
Ex: -user @user
legacy.flag.minimaltime:
Remove tracks with the given minimum duration.
Ex: -min 1:23.
legacy.flag.mix: Add/play recommended tracks based on the given artist - track name.
legacy.flag.next: Add the track/playlist to the top of the queue (same as: -pos 1)
legacy.flag.playlist:
Remove tracks from the associated playlist with the given name.
Ex: -playlist myplaylist
legacy.flag.position_play:
Put the track in a specific queue position (ignored if you use -next etc).
Ex: -p 10
legacy.flag.resetids: Reset the tracks' id info (useful to avoid problems with certain lavaplayer/lavalink changes).
legacy.flag.reverse: Reverse the order of the added tracks (only effective when adding a playlist).
legacy.flag.select: Pick the track among the results found.
legacy.flag.shuffle: Shuffle the added tracks (only effective when adding a playlist).
legacy.flag.songtitle:
include the name in the track.
Ex: -name NCS
legacy.flag.startposition:
Remove tracks from a starting queue position.
Ex: -start 10
legacy.flag.uploader:
Remove tracks whose author/artist/uploader contains the given name.
Ex: -uploader sekai

erasure.owner.dm:
**Pedido de apagamento dos seus dados / Request to delete your data**

🇧🇷 Em seu nome, foi pedido a quem opera este bot o apagamento dos seus dados pessoais, em geral porque você escreveu a essa pessoa (por e-mail, por exemplo). Quem opera o bot não pode confirmar por você: este pedido só apaga algo se você tocar em **Apagar tudo** aqui. Se não foi você, toque em Cancelar ou ignore esta mensagem.
Apagar remove o que o bot guarda sobre você: prefixo, favoritos, integrações, acesso do app de Rich Presence, últimas músicas, vínculo com o Last.fm, fila salva, fila de scrobbles, rádios favoritas, lista pessoal de rádios, seu ID nos registros de quem mudou rádios e sessões do painel. Ficam os registros de acesso e de segurança por até 6 meses, para proteger o serviço e cumprir a lei, o registro de banimento, se houver, o que já foi enviado ao Last.fm e, até o player acabar, o registro de quem pediu cada música. Cópias de segurança podem guardar dados apagados por até 4 semanas. **Não dá para desfazer.** O pedido vale por até 24 horas.

🇺🇸 On your behalf, whoever runs this bot was asked to delete your personal data, usually because you contacted them (by e-mail, for example). Whoever runs the bot cannot confirm for you: this request only deletes anything if you tap **Delete everything** here. If this was not you, tap Cancel or ignore this message.
Deleting removes what the bot keeps about you: prefix, favorites, integrations, Rich Presence app access, recent tracks, Last.fm link, saved queue, scrobble queue, favorite radios, personal radio list, your ID in the records of who changed radios and panel sessions. Access and security records stay for up to 6 months, to protect the service and comply with the law. Any ban record and what was already sent to Last.fm also stay, as does, until the player stops, the record of who requested each track. Backup copies may keep erased data for up to 4 weeks. **This cannot be undone.** The request is valid for up to 24 hours.
